cues.text: A sixty-year-old man has a large carcinoma of the upper left lung.
His chest X-ray also shows marked elevation of the left hemidiaphragm.
The phrenic nerve supplies the diaphragm.
When the carcinoma infiltrates the phrenic nerve, the diaphragm is paralysed,
and the left dome is elevated.
So the nerve affected by the carcinoma is the phrenic nerve.
